No close-up of sensor, lens glass, or body surfaces to check for scratches, dust, or fungus.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the camera's nameplate/model number and brand logo together
Photo or video of the camera powering on and a live view/autofocus test
Close-up photos of both lenses' barrel text (focal length, aperture)
Photo of shutter count or EXIF info from a test shot
Photo of sensor (body cap off) and lens elements against light for scratches/fungus/dust
Photo of all accessories included (battery, charger, memory card, strap, bag)
response.reason: The seller claims the camera is a Canon, but the witness clearly saw a Nikon logo on the body, a direct contradiction on the item's core identity that warrants suspicion before any pricing.
